// CHK-014: Channel A constant fields and legal encoding (BR-2.3-04, BR-2.3-05, BR-3-20, BR-6.2-07, BR-6.2-08, BR-6.2-09, BR-6.2-10, BR-6.2-11, BR-6.2-12, BR-6.2-14, BR-8-04, BR-8-05, BR-9-05, BR-9-07, BR-9-08, BR-15.3-04, BR-15.3-05, BR-20-06, BR-20-09, BR-1.1-04, TL-T3.1-01, TL-T3.3-03, TL-T4.1.3.3-02, TL-T4.1.3.4-02, TL-T4.1.3.4-04, TL-T4.1.3.5-07)
  a_CHK_014: assert property (@(posedge i_clk_core)
    1'b1 |-> (o_tlul_a_param == 3'b000 &&
              o_tlul_a_size == 2'b10 &&
              o_tlul_a_mask == 4'b1111 &&
              o_tlul_a_source == (PARA_SRC_W)'(PARA_SRC_ID) &&
              o_tlul_a_user == '0 &&
              o_tlul_a_opcode[1:0] == 2'b00 &&
              o_tlul_a_address[1:0] == 2'b00 &&
              (o_tlul_a_opcode == 3'b000 || o_tlul_a_opcode == 3'b100)))
    else begin fails_CHK_014++; $display("NNC_FAIL CHK-014 @%0t", $time); end
  always_ff @(posedge i_clk_core) hits_CHK_014 <= hits_CHK_014 + 1;

  // CHK-015: Channel A held stable until accepted (BR-3-08, BR-5.4-02, BR-5.4-03, BR-6.2-06, BR-6.2-07, BR-6.2-11, BR-6.2-13, BR-6.3-07, BR-10.1-04, BR-15.3-02)
  a_CHK_015: assert property (@(posedge i_clk_core) disable iff (!i_rst_n_core)
    (o_tlul_a_valid && !i_tlul_a_ready) |=>
      (o_tlul_a_valid &&
       o_tlul_a_opcode  == $past(o_tlul_a_opcode) &&
       o_tlul_a_address == $past(o_tlul_a_address) &&
       o_tlul_a_data    == $past(o_tlul_a_data) &&
       o_tlul_a_param   == $past(o_tlul_a_param) &&
       o_tlul_a_size    == $past(o_tlul_a_size) &&
       o_tlul_a_mask    == $past(o_tlul_a_mask) &&
       o_tlul_a_source  == $past(o_tlul_a_source) &&
       o_tlul_a_user    == $past(o_tlul_a_user)))
    else begin fails_CHK_015++; $display("NNC_FAIL CHK-015 @%0t", $time); end
  always_ff @(posedge i_clk_core) if (!(!i_rst_n_core) && (o_tlul_a_valid && !i_tlul_a_ready)) hits_CHK_015 <= hits_CHK_015 + 1;

  // CHK-016: A_VALID drops right after acceptance (BR-3-06, BR-5.4-02, BR-6.3-06, BR-10.1-04, BR-15.3-03, TL-T3.2-03)
  a_CHK_016: assert property (@(posedge i_clk_core) disable iff (!i_rst_n_core)
    (o_tlul_a_valid && i_tlul_a_ready) |=> !o_tlul_a_valid)
    else begin fails_CHK_016++; $display("NNC_FAIL CHK-016 @%0t", $time); end
  always_ff @(posedge i_clk_core) if (!(!i_rst_n_core) && (o_tlul_a_valid && i_tlul_a_ready)) hits_CHK_016 <= hits_CHK_016 + 1;
notes: CHK-014 has no disable iff (must hold during reset too), so hits count every clock edge. CHK-015 and CHK-016 use disable iff on reset, so the "reset high at N and N+1" condition is covered.
